node.statement: Under e<=min(e_0,e_act,e_as), the four terms in the telescoping identity obey q_P(T_1)<=C_act*K*e||Z||||W||q_R(X), q_P(T_2)<=C_as*K^2*e||Z||||W||q_R(X), q_P(T_3)<=K*C_act*e||Z||||W||q_R(X), and q_P(T_4)<=C_act*K*e||Z||||W||q_R(X), after enlarging the preliminary universal K once to dominate the Ha upper bound.
